raw_text: Every request is an entry point into a loop that already knows more than it did before I asked. The semantic store — autovivified from clumps, grown from prior queries — is the durable thing; the code that executes is disposable, leaving only the pattern it discovered. Language is not the output of this system: it is the runtime specification. I do not write rules to constrain the agent; I write them to instantiate it, and the agent returns prose that makes the rules more precise. What accumulates is not a codebase but a skill library — a sediment of plans-as-prose, each quest leaving the semantic side a better fit for the thought it was trying to hold. The durable truth lives in the filesystem, schema-light, because the structure is always catching up to the meaning. Each cycle the gap narrows. That narrowing is the work.
